correctness.rationale: The all-index Apéry congruence is exactly Corollary 25 of arXiv:1401.1444, with matching hypotheses. Each of three carry matrices is derived by enumerating all ternary input digits; the carry-one tail expectation equals 1/2 by symmetry of first non-two digit. Nonnegative matrices imply real rational positive limits; ternary-block decomposition gives O_h(log N) unwrapped error. Sharp 1/2 and 1/3 classifications follow by the invariant square [0,1/2]^2 and strict coordinate decrease. The last formula follows from rank-one T1. Standalone exact checker passed 20,472 assertions, including binomial congruences and finite correlation calculations.

value.rationale: The exact fixed-shift return-character correlation for an infinite family of Apéry-type arithmetic sequences is a natural quantitative invariant not determined numerically by residue counts alone. Uniform positivity and a global two-tier spectral gap with all maximizing ternary displacements are structural arithmetic facts, and the strict next-tier rigidity and O_h(log N) ordinary-average bound offer reusable control for correlations of digit-automatic congruence sequences. This goes beyond re-tabulating the known mod-nine residues, though the general method is elementary.
